pack_name: Agentic Synth Twin External Targets v1
purpose: External non-Surge target audio for evaluating preset retrieval and bounded Surge XT parameter refinement.

generation.method: Original deterministic procedural DSP generated in Python/NumPy.

audition_contract.note: Percussive targets naturally decay before the 2.0 s hold boundary; all files still use the same 2.5 s container duration.

targets.title: Analog Sub Bass
targets.recipe: Additive saw + octave-down sine + odd-harmonic square, one-pole low-pass at 520 Hz, fast attack, 2.0 s hold, 0.5 s release.

targets.title: FM Bell
targets.recipe: Two-operator FM with 2.73 modulator/carrier ratio, exponentially decaying modulation index, plus an inharmonic partial and bell-like amplitude decay.

targets.title: Plucked Electric Guitar
targets.recipe: Deterministic Karplus-Strong digital string with pick-position comb shaping, body/pickup-style delay coloration, low-pass damping, and mild saturation.

targets.title: Rhodes-style Electric Piano
targets.recipe: Original tine/pickup-inspired model: fundamental plus slightly inharmonic upper partials with independent decays, a short filtered hammer-noise transient, and mild pickup-style saturation. No sampled or modeled commercial preset.

targets.title: Muted Synth Pluck
targets.recipe: Saw/pulse excitation through a rapidly closing sample-varying low-pass filter and short exponential amplitude decay.

targets.title: Analog Brass Stab
targets.recipe: Three detuned saw oscillators with a fast-opening/decaying low-pass filter envelope, brass-like amplitude contour, and subtle saturation.

targets.title: Warm Poly Pad
targets.recipe: Detuned saw pair plus triangle oscillator, slow low-pass modulation, deterministic short-delay chorus coloration, slow attack, and long release.

targets.title: Sync / Hard Lead
targets.recipe: Hard-sync-style phase-reset approximation with a decaying slave/master ratio sweep, bright transient, low-pass contour, sustain, and mild saturation.

targets.title: Marimba / Mallet
targets.recipe: Struck-bar modal synthesis using four non-harmonic resonant modes with progressively shorter decays plus a tiny filtered mallet-noise transient.

targets.title: Dub Chord / Organ Stab
targets.recipe: Additive drawbar-inspired organ partials plus a quiet fifth, short stab envelope, low-pass tone shaping, mild saturation, and one deterministic short echo tap.
